ns2:section.sectionText: New Technologies in Cell & Developmental Biology New technologies are revolutionizing the scientific discovery process. In this special topic class, we will discuss recent primary research articles reporting breakthroughs in technologies in Cell and Developmental biology, including CRISPR-Cas technologies, Optogenetic control of gene expression and cell activity, as well as recent development in Proteomic, chromatin and RNA technologies. The goal is to stimulate inspirations for applying new technologies in graduate students’ own thesis research.
